LuaScript:
-- Tribute · TTS loader (generated by "Tribute - TTS Export"; edits here are overwritten on the next publish).
-- On load it reads manifest.json from the asset repo and points every object on the table
-- at the newest published version of its images. Right-click the table for "check for updates".
local REPO = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RedDjinnPro/tribute-tts/main/"
local applied = "2026-10-11 19:14"

local function base(url)
  local q = string.find(url, "?", 1, true)
  if q then return string.sub(url, 1, q - 1) end
  return url
end

local function rewrite(t, map)
  local changed = false
  for k, v in pairs(t) do
    if type(v) == "string" then
      local new = map[base(v)]
      if new and new ~= v then t[k] = new; changed = true end
    elseif type(v) == "table" then
      if rewrite(v, map) then changed = true end
    end
  end
  return changed
end

function onLoad(saved)
  if saved and saved ~= "" then
    local s = JSON.decode(saved)
    if s and s.applied then applied = s.applied end
  end
  addContextMenuItem("Tribute: check for updates", function() checkManifest(true) end)
  checkManifest(false)
end

function onSave()
  return JSON.encode({applied = applied})
end

function checkManifest(loud)
  WebRequest.get(REPO .. "manifest.json?t=" .. os.time(), function(req)
    if req.is_error or (req.response_code and req.response_code ~= 200) then
      if loud then broadcastToAll("Tribute: could not reach the asset repo.", {1, 0.55, 0.45}) end
      return
    end
    local m = JSON.decode(req.text)
    if not m or not m.assets then return end
    if m.version == applied then
      if loud then broadcastToAll("Tribute: up to date (" .. m.version .. ").", {0.7, 0.9, 0.6}) end
      return
    end
    applyManifest(m)
  end)
end

function applyManifest(m)
  local map = {}
  for path, hash in pairs(m.assets) do map[REPO .. path] = REPO .. path .. "?v=" .. hash end
  local n = 0
  for _, obj in ipairs(getObjects()) do
    local data = obj.getData()
    if data and rewrite(data, map) then
      local pos, rot = obj.getPosition(), obj.getRotation()
      obj.destruct()
      spawnObjectData({data = data, position = pos, rotation = rot})
      n = n + 1
    end
  end
  applied = m.version
  broadcastToAll("Tribute: updated to " .. m.version .. " (" .. n .. " objects refreshed).", {0.86, 0.75, 0.49})
end
